About Me

Hello! My name is Tanish and I love building things — from LLM-powered data pipelines to full-stack apps and competitive programming solutions. My journey into software started with a fascination for algorithms, and it quickly evolved into a passion for AI, machine learning, and intelligent systems.

I'm currently a final-year B.Tech student in Mathematics & Computing at DTU where I've interned as an AI Engineer at NTT DATA Business Solutions and as an ML Engineer at BiUP.ai , building production systems used by 25,000+ users monthly.

I'm also a Core Member at Geek Room , a community of 100,000+ coders, where I help organise hackathons, hireathons, and workshops. Outside of work, I'm a competitive programmer with 1600+ rating and 400+ problems solved across LeetCode, Codeforces, and CSES.

Some Things I've Built

  • Featured Project

    CodeTracer

    A production-grade LeetCode alternative with a real-time contest system, full social layer, and secure C++ code execution via Judge0 in sandboxed environments. Features an AI coaching agent that dynamically renders algorithm visualizations through interactive React components, plus a Web Worker-based execution engine with a custom Tracer class API for real-time animated playback.

    • React

  • Featured Project

    YTFeed

    A Chrome extension that enhances YouTube recommendations by integrating community-contributed video links. Injects category-based recommended links into users’ YouTube feed using the Chrome API, simulating natural recommendations to enhance the user experience.

    • Chrome Extension
    • Flask
    • PostgreSQL

  • Featured Project

    Zomato Restaurant Recommendation

    A smart recommendation app that generates restaurant embeddings using Qdrant vector database and adapts recommendations based on user feedback. Integrates HNSW indexing and SQLite for persistence, and incorporates Bayesian ratings and budget preferences for personalized results.

    • Qdrant
    • SQLite
